text:
Maya Sinha: FYI dropping the company-level OKR draft for the next quarter, link: https://docs.redwood.com/okrs/q3-draft — need alignment + final signoff by EOD tomorrow.
Ethan Cole: skimmed — overall looks good. Flag: infra SLOs under 'Reliability' are a bit optimistic given current tail latency. Can we scope the latency target or add a fallback plan?
Lena Ortiz: Mainly worried about the cost guardrails under 'Efficiency'. We need a concrete measurement and a finance-approved threshold before signoff. Suggest adding a 10% cap on incremental inference spend.
Sofia Park: Customers asked for more predictable latency SLAs (esp. for Dedicated). Can we make one of the success metrics a customer-facing SLA pilot with 3 references?
Jonas Kim: agree with Ethan — also recommend we split 'Launch' into Canary -> Gradual rollout -> Scale. Keep the initial feature set tight so ops isn't overwhelmed.
Maya Sinha: Good points. Proposed edits: relax latency target from 95th=120ms to 95th=140ms for v1; add cost cap as Lena suggested; add customer SLA pilot as Sofia asked. Will update doc in the next hour. @ravi any redlines from execs?
Ravi Narayan: No hard redlines, mainly want clear tradeoffs documented. If the cost cap means delaying a non-critical feature, that's OK. Prioritize reliability & enterprise readiness.
Ethan Cole: one more technical ask — please call out the rollback criteria (error rate >2% for 10m or latency >250ms sustained 5m). Otherwise we may be stuck chasing incidents.
Maya Sinha: adding rollback criteria now. Drafting a short rollout checklist — putting here for visibility:

```
Rollout checklist (v1):
- Canary (5% traffic, 24h)
- Monitor: error rate, 95p latency, token cost/day
- If error rate > 2% for 10m or 95p latency >250ms for 5m -> rollback
- Gradual increase 5% steps, 6h between increments
- Validate with 3 pilot customers before full scale
```

Lena Ortiz: That checklist is helpful. Can you also add a cost-monitoring alert (daily burn above forecast triggers hold) and a contact (finance-oncall) in the plan?
Maya Sinha: will add finance-oncall and daily burn alert.
Jonas Kim: small ask — can eng include an ops playbook link in the doc (runbook + rollback cmds)? I'll attach after this thread.
Maya Sinha: noted. Final ask: can everyone reply with a one-line thumbs or minor edits by EOD? I'll lock the doc after that.
Ethan Cole: thumbs, small note: remove planned pre-warming for 3rd party models until perf verified.
Lena Ortiz: +1, finance fine with 10% cap as long as we get weekly spend snapshots.
Sofia Park: +1 :shipit: — I'll coordinate pilot customers.
Jonas Kim: +1, will upload runbook in doc.
Ravi Narayan: +1 — thanks Maya and team. Document the tradeoffs in the header so execs can scan.
Maya Sinha: Great — locking doc tomorrow morning. Thanks all! :lock:
